items.title: The fake news game: actively inoculating against the risk of misinformation

judge.evidence_topic: we developed a ‘fake news game’ in which participants are actively tasked with creating a news article about a strongly politicized issue (the European refugee crisis)
judge.evidence_empirical: we conducted a randomized field study (N = 95) in a public high school setting.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (randomizado) sobre um jogo de inoculação (fake news game) que não se enquadra nas exclusões (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições ou política partidária). O achado está sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Fake news game confers psychological resistance against online misinformation

judge.evidence_topic: In a novel attempt to address this issue, we designed a psychological intervention in the form of an online browser game. In the game, players take on the role of a fake news producer and learn to master six documented techniques commonly used in the production of misinformation... The game draws on an inoculation metaphor, where preemptively exposing, warning, and familiarising people with the strategies used in the production of fake news helps confer cognitive immunity when exposed to real misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: We conducted a large-scale evaluation of the game with N = 15,000 participants in a pre-post gameplay design.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um jogo de inoculação (Bad News) para combater desinformação, utilizando um desenho pré-pós com 15.000 participantes, o que atende aos critérios de inclusão. O achado principal está diretamente sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Good News about Bad News: Gamified Inoculation Boosts Confidence and Cognitive Immunity Against Fake News

judge.evidence_topic: A recent example is the Bad News game, an online fake news game in which players learn about six common misinformation techniques.
judge.evidence_empirical: Using a 2 (treatment vs. control) × 2 (pre vs. post) mixed design (N = 196) we measure participants’ ability to spot misinformation techniques in 18 fake headlines before and after playing Bad News.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um experimento empírico com o jogo Bad News, que está dentro do escopo. O método e os achados extraídos estão corretamente alinhados com o resumo.

items.title: Prebunking interventions based on the psychological theory of "inoculation" can reduce susceptibility to misinformation across cultures
Long-term effectiveness of inoculation against misinformation: Three longitudinal experiments

judge.evidence_topic: We tested the effectiveness of Bad News, a real-world intervention in which participants develop resistance against misinformation through exposure to weakened doses of misinformation techniques.
judge.evidence_empirical: Using 3 longitudinal experiments (2 preregistered), we tested the effectiveness of Bad News... In 3 experiments (NExp1 = 151, NExp2 = 194, NExp3 = 170), participants played either Bad News (inoculation group) or Tetris (gamified control group)
judge.reason: O artigo trata de um jogo de inoculação (Bad News) contra desinformação, sem focar nos temas excluídos (COVID, vacinas, eleições, política). O método descrito (experimentos longitudinais) é empírico e condiz com o resumo. O achado principal reflete corretamente os resultados descritos no resumo sobre a eficácia e a duração do efeito de inoculação.

items.title: Technique-based inoculation against real-world misinformation

judge.evidence_topic: In this study, we address two open questions related to technique-based inoculation in two separate experiments (total n = 2188; convenience sample recruited via the Bad News online game platform)
judge.evidence_empirical: In this study, we address two open questions related to technique-based inoculation in two separate experiments (total n = 2188; convenience sample recruited via the Bad News online game platform)
judge.reason: O resumo confirma 'two separate experiments', validando o método. O achado principal extraído é sustentado pela frase: "We find that playing a 15 min game confers psychological resistance against real-world misinformation that makes use of manipulation techniques against which people were inoculated (Cohen's d = 0.37, Cohen's U 3 = 64.4%, p < 0.001), and that cross-protection is achieved but at a reduced effect size ( d = 0.10, U 3 = 54.0%, p = 0.001)."

items.title: Bad News in the civics classroom: How serious gameplay fosters teenagers' ability to discern misinformation techniques

judge.evidence_topic: Although the serious game Bad News has been used to inoculate citizens against misinformation, it has not been formally evaluated in traditional classrooms.
judge.evidence_empirical: We therefore evaluated its impact on 516 upper-secondary Swedish students playing individually, paired, or with the whole class.
judge.reason: O artigo trata do jogo Bad News (inoculação) em contexto educacional, sem abordar os temas excluídos (COVID, vacinas, eleições). O estudo é empírico, com coleta de dados própria (pré e pós-intervenção), e os dados extraídos refletem fielmente o resumo.

items.title: Game-based inoculation versus graphic-based inoculation to combat misinformation: a randomized controlled trial

judge.evidence_topic: This study employed inoculation theory and developed an interactive game to help the public counter misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: A total of 180 Chinese participants were randomly assigned to game-based inoculation, graphic-based inoculation, and control groups.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (RCT) sobre um jogo de inoculação contra desinformação, sem focar nos temas excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições ou política partidária). Os dados extraídos estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: How to "inoculate" against multimodal misinformation: A conceptual replication of Roozenbeek and van der Linden (2020)

judge.evidence_topic: We developed a game called Cat Park , in which players learn about five manipulation techniques (trolling, emotional manipulation, amplification, polarization, and conspiracism), and how misinformation can spread through images.
judge.evidence_empirical: To test the game’s efficacy, we conducted a conceptual replication ( N = 380) of Roozenbeek and van der Linden’s 2020 study about Harmony Square , with the same study design, item set, and hypotheses.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (experimento) sobre um jogo de inoculação (Cat Park) que não trata de temas proibidos (COVID, vacinas, eleições, política). O método e o achado principal estão corretamente descritos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Feedback exercises boost discernment of misinformation for gamified inoculation interventions

judge.evidence_topic: Gamification is a promising approach to reducing misinformation susceptibility. Previous research has found that 'inoculation' games such as Bad News and Harmony Square help build cognitive resistance against misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: We address these issues in two preregistered lab experiments (N1 = 191, N2 = 321) and four quasi-experimental in-game surveys implemented in Harmony Square (N3 = 559) and Bad News (N4 = 2,558, N5 = 419, N6 = 882).
judge.reason: O artigo trata de jogos de inoculação (Bad News e Harmony Square) e utiliza métodos empíricos (experimentos e quase-experimentos) para avaliar o impacto de exercícios de feedback. O achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Playing Gali Fakta inoculates Indonesian participants against false information

judge.evidence_topic: we developed Gali Fakta, a new kind of media literacy game specifically tailored for an Indonesian audience.
judge.evidence_empirical: Our findings indicate that participants who engaged with Gali Fakta exhibited significantly greater skepticism toward false news headlines and expressed a reduced likelihood of sharing them.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico sobre um jogo de prebunking (Gali Fakta) na Indonésia, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão e excluindo os temas proibidos. O método e os achados estão alinhados com o resumo.

items.title: Gamified Inoculation Against Misinformation in India: A Randomized Control Trial

judge.evidence_topic: We report the results of a game-based intervention against misinformation in India.
judge.evidence_empirical: the present study conducted in north India (n = 757)
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um ensaio controlado randomizado (RCT) sobre um jogo de inoculação contra desinformação, o que está alinhado com o pedido. O estudo é empírico, utiliza um método adequado (RCT) e o achado principal extraído é fiel ao que está escrito no resumo.

items.title: Misinformation Is Contagious: Middle school students learn how to evaluate and share information responsibly through a digital game
Learning to evaluate (mis)information in an online game: Strategies matter!

judge.evidence_topic: Digital games can help students learn how to cope with misinformation. ... The participants were 132 8th and 9th-grade students who played different versions of a misinformation game
judge.evidence_empirical: The participants were 132 8th and 9th-grade students who played different versions of a misinformation game that either simulated evaluation strategies or did not simulate them and either included misinformation explanations or did not include them.
judge.reason: O artigo trata de um jogo digital sobre desinformação, é um estudo empírico experimental com 132 alunos, e o achado principal está explicitamente descrito no resumo.

items.title: Can pre-service teachers learn about fake news by playing an augmented reality escape game?

judge.evidence_topic: The aim of this study is to address this gap by examining whether pre-service teachers can learn about fake news using the augmented reality escape game Escape Fake.
judge.evidence_empirical: To investigate this question, a pre-/post-test design was conducted with 45 pre-service teachers (four males, mean age=22.59 years, standard deviation=1.80).
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (pré/pós-teste) com um jogo educativo (Escape Fake) sobre desinformação, sem violar as restrições de tema (não é sobre COVID, vacinas ou política). Os dados extraídos refletem fielmente o método e os resultados apresentados no resumo.

items.title: Playing an Augmented Reality Escape Game Promotes Learning About Fake News

judge.evidence_topic: In this study, we focus on Escape Fake , an augmented reality (AR) escape game developed for use in media literacy education.
judge.evidence_empirical: In this study, we conducted a field study using a pretest-posttest research design.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (pré-teste/pós-teste) sobre um jogo educativo (Escape Fake) voltado para a alfabetização midiática e combate a fake news, sem abordar os temas excluídos (COVID, eleições, etc.). Os dados extraídos estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Mixed News about the Bad News Game

judge.evidence_topic: Basol et al. (2020) tested the “the Bad News Game” (BNG), an app designed to improve ability to spot false claims on social media... Here, four teams of undergraduate psychology students each attempted an extended replication of Basol et al.
judge.evidence_empirical: Here, four teams of undergraduate psychology students each attempted an extended replication of Basol et al., using updated versions of the original Bad News game.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (réplicas) sobre o jogo Bad News, que se enquadra no tema de inoculação contra desinformação. O método e os achados estão corretamente descritos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Re-examining the bad news game: No evidence of improved discrimination of Indian true and fake news headlines

judge.reason: O artigo trata do jogo Bad News (inoculação) contra desinformação, utilizando um delineamento experimental (pré e pós-teste) com coleta de dados novos (N=150), não se enquadrando nas exclusões de COVID-19, vacinas, eleições ou política partidária. items.title: Developing Resilience to Disinformation: A Game-Based Method for Future Communicators

judge.evidence_topic: This paper analyzes the outcomes of a game-based educational process aiming to strengthen resilience to fake news.
judge.evidence_empirical: Cognitive learning outcomes as well as learning dynamics were assessed using pre- and end-of game surveys.

O achado principal sobre a reflexão dos estudantes e o pensamento crítico está diretamente sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Inoculation against conspiracy theories: A consumer side approach to India's fake news problem

judge.evidence_topic: We attempt to replicate Roozenbeek and van der Linden's Western‐based study in India by employing the Bad News Game , an online game, in which players take on the role of a misinformation tycoon.
judge.evidence_empirical: We test the game's impact on an Indian sample ( n = 1002) using a within‐subject design.
judge.reason: O artigo utiliza o jogo Bad News para testar a inoculação contra desinformação em uma amostra indiana, utilizando um delineamento intrassujeito, o que está de acordo com os critérios de inclusão. O achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Effects of inductive learning and gamification on news veracity discernment

judge.evidence_topic: The main intervention involved inductive learning (IL) training (i.e., practice discriminating between multiple true and fake news exemplars with feedback) with or without gamification... or a Bad News intervention, a notable web-based game designed to tackle online misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: Participants (N = 282 Prolific users) were randomly assigned to either a gamified IL intervention, a nongamified version of the same IL intervention, a no-treatment control group, or a Bad News intervention.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico (experimento randomizado) que avalia o jogo Bad News como uma das condições experimentais para o discernimento da veracidade de notícias, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão. O achado extraído reflete fielmente o resultado relatado no resumo.

items.title: Can an online educational game contribute to developing information literate citizens?

judge.evidence_topic: We developed an online educational game designed to enhance core media and information literacy competencies and to help young adults become information literate citizens. We examined the game's effects on skepticism toward online information and information discernment skills
judge.evidence_empirical: In an online experiment, a total of 210 participants between 20 and 29 years of age were randomly assigned to one of three groups
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um experimento online randomizado com 210 participantes para avaliar um jogo educativo de letramento midiático, o que está em total conformidade com os critérios de inclusão (estudo empírico, jogo educativo, sem temas proibidos). Os dados extraídos refletem fielmente o resumo.
